mode: local implementation-readiness audit with generated fast regression
scope: Cover DataStorage linker branches where only the explicit lexical key or numeric handle is supplied

localCodeInspection: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp::linkDataStorage has separate explicit-key, explicit-handle, and entity-handle fallback branches

tests/hardening_tests.cpp::testDwgModelerDataStorageLinking already covered both explicit views, no explicit views, mismatched views, duplicate sections/claims, and a known wrong-version section, but not either single-explicit-view branch or an UNKNOWNV section
method.limitations: Generated in-memory cases establish linker identity selection and orphan accounting only. They do not qualify DWG producer behavior, SAB syntax/semantics, or external consumer acceptance.

behavior: Added a key-only case whose entity handle points at a different record; the explicit key selects its exact handle and payload.
Added a numeric-handle-only case whose entity handle points elsewhere; the explicit numeric identity selects its exact canonical key and payload.
Added missing-key and missing-numeric-handle cases that refuse to recover from the entity handle, leaving the records unclaimed for orphan accounting.
Added an UNKNOWNV-section case that links only through the explicit handle/key identity and finalizes with no orphan or link failure.
Added the AC1024 early-return control against an AC1027 DataStorage section.
Added an AC1027 entity with populated handle fields but no hasDsData advertisement; it cannot claim the record.
Recorded the next local action as the linked-payload cap refusal edge in the graph-preservation owner.

validation.commitBlocker: The task environment exposes .git as read-only and the shared worktree already contains extensive unrelated user changes; no files were staged.
